Prior events (Part 1): Kurapika interrogates the captured Phantom Troupe enforcer Uvogin about the slaughter of the Kurta clan, leading to an explosive confrontation when the monster casually mocks the massacre.
Prior events (Part 2): Kurapika’s chains expose the limit of Uvogin’s power, then the fight turns toward a deadly reveal.
Prior events (Part 3): Kurapika's chains bring Uvogin down, but his final open eye leaves his death uncertain.
